decision.reason: The only evidence is a one-line release-note entry [ev-6d7e63820de1]. It combines two separate changes: the eks:eks-cluster-name tag is added and the karpenter.sh/managed-by annotation is removed. It does not say which resources carry either one or what happens to anything that relied on the removed annotation. Beyond that, it only points to PR #6589. Separate evidence for each change is needed, such as the upgrade guide or the PR diff, showing which resources are affected and what dependents of karpenter.sh/managed-by should expect.
